system.specialAbility:
You become Trained in Guile and Insight, and you become Trained in a relevant Lore of your choice.

Example Lores include Lore of a royal court, Heraldry Lore, Lore of a noble household.
system.description: You served in a household where a misplaced word could do more damage than a drawn blade. You learned to recognize influence and conceal your intentions behind the proper courtesies.
